doc.name: Strike Mission Surf Trip Planner
doc.instructions: Use Strike Mission when a user asks where to surf, where to fly for surf, how to avoid flat surf trips, or how to compare surf destinations by ability and forecast window.

tools.name: recommend_surf_trip_destinations
tools.title: Recommend surf trip destinations
tools.description: Use this when a user asks where to surf, where to fly for surf, how to plan a landlocked surfer trip, or which destinations fit their ability. Returns Strike Mission destination candidates with ability fit, season, travel, hazards, and dashboard links. For near-term trips (this month), candidates are ranked by live 10-day Strike Scores.

surferLevel.description: User ability level. Use intermediate when the user can catch green waves and go down the line.

travelMonth.description: Target travel month from 1 to 12. Omit to use the current month.

originAirport.description: Optional IATA origin airport, for example DEN, LAX, JFK, LHR, SYD.

preferredRegions.description: Optional regions to prefer, for example Central America, Europe, Pacific, Southeast Asia.

preferredCountries.description: Optional countries to prefer, for example Mexico, Costa Rica, Portugal.

warmWaterOnly.description: Set true when the user wants warm-water or boardshort-friendly surf.

avoidHeavyWaves.description: Set true for beginners, intermediates, family trips, or anyone avoiding serious reef/slab conditions.

includeBoatAccess.description: Set true if boat-only waves are acceptable.

tools.name: compare_surf_destinations
tools.title: Compare surf destinations
tools.description: Use this when a user is deciding between specific countries, regions, or surf spots. Compares Strike Mission fit by ability level, season, travel access, hazards, consistency, and recommended spot candidates.

destinations.description: Countries, regions, or spot names to compare, for example Mexico, Costa Rica, Portugal, Bali, Uluwatu.

travelMonth.description: Target travel month from 1 to 12. Omit to use the current month.

tools.name: get_spot_planning_context
tools.title: Get surf spot planning context
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about a specific surf spot. Returns difficulty, hazards, season, travel access, wave type, swell/wind requirements, and Strike Mission links.

spot.description: Spot name, slug, or numeric Strike Mission spot id, for example Uluwatu, uluwatu, or 1.

tools.name: get_live_spot_forecast
tools.title: Get live Strike Score forecast
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether a specific surf spot is worth surfing or traveling to soon. Fetches the live 10-day Strike Mission forecast and best days for one spot.

spot.description: Spot name, slug, or numeric Strike Mission spot id, for example Uluwatu, uluwatu, or 1.

tools.name: find_surf_trip_guides
tools.title: Find surf trip planning guides
tools.description: Use this when the user wants surf trip planning guidance, such as landlocked surfer planning, where to surf next, avoiding flat trips, cheap surf flights, or Surfline alternatives.

query.description: Optional free-form user query to match against guide titles and keywords.

resources.name: Strike Mission surf trip planner
resources.description: Interactive summary view for Strike Mission surf trip recommendations.
